name: gui-agent
summary: FastMCP server for desktop computer use and GUI automation with mouse, keyboard, OCR and video.

features.title: Click and move the mouse cursor
Find text on the screen with OCR
Take screenshots with a coordinate grid

steps.command: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/leandre755/gui_agent.git /tmp/gui_agent 2>&1 && echo CLONED && ls /tmp/gui_agent && cat /tmp/gui_agent/pyproject.toml 2>&1
steps.purpose: Clone repo to inspect and patch build

steps.command:
cp -r /tmp/gui_agent /tmp/gui_fix && grep -n evdev /tmp/gui_fix/pyproject.toml
sed -i 's/.*evdev.*/# evdev removed for sandbox (no kernel headers)/' /tmp/gui_fix/pyproject.toml && grep -n evdev /tmp/gui_fix/pyproject.toml; echo ---; cat /tmp/gui_fix/pyproject.toml | grep -A2 -B2 dependencies -m1
steps.purpose: Remove evdev dep needing kernel headers

cp -r /tmp/gui_agent /tmp/gui_fix && grep -n evdev /tmp/gui_fix/pyproject.toml

pitfalls.actually_needed: PyPI gui-agent 0.0.1 installs but provides no executables; must install from git URL
remove/replace evdev dependency or install linux-headers via apt (needs root); evdev has no wheel and its build fails without kernel headers

pitfalls.readme_said: gui-agent launches as stdio MCP server
pitfalls.actually_needed: running X server with DISPLAY set; import of pyautogui/mouseinfo crashes without /tmp/.X11-unix socket

what_it_does.quote: Lightweight, ultra-fast FastMCP server for Computer Use & GUI automation on Linux and Windows (Mouse, Keyboard, OCR, Video, Web).

who_it_is_for.quote: Autonomous AI agents interacting with modern graphical user interfaces are frequently burdened by fragmented architectures

prerequisites.quote: Under Linux, install the native window management, OCR, multimedia, AT-SPI accessibility, and Rust build libraries:

without external cloud vision dependencies or persistent background daemons.
Operating through a single, resilient standard input/output (stdio) FastMCP connection,
Injects physical mouse click events (`left`, `right`, `middle`, double) at target `(x, y)` coordinates
Injects standard keystrokes, navigation hotkeys, and chord combinations (active runtime aliases: `gui_keyboard_press`, `gui_keyboard_type`)
Discovers on-screen text coordinates via local OCR without sending image payloads (active runtime alias: `gui_find_text`)
Captures raw framebuffer with calibrated Cartesian grid overlays for opaque surfaces (active runtime alias: `gui_take_screenshot`)
